subject: general
question: The High court of Delhi was established in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1966**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The High Court of Delhi was established on **31st October 1966** under the **Delhi High Court Act, 1966**.
 
• Prior to the establishment of the High Court of Delhi in 1966, the administration of justice in Delhi was under the Punjab High Court.
 
• The Delhi High Court has jurisdiction over Delhi, New Delhi.
